ingredients.name: Lucky Charms frosted toasted oat cereal with marshmallows

instructions.primary_message: Line the bottom and sides of a large baking dish with parchment paper and set aside.
Remove about a ½-cup of Lucky Charms marshmallows from the box and set aside for garnish (set remaining cereal aside for later use).
instructions.secondary_message: 1 (297 g) box Lucky Charms frosted toasted oat cereal with marshmallows

instructions.primary_message: Place butter in a large pot and melt over medium-low heat.
Add mini marshmallows to the pot and heat, stirring constantly, until melted and combined with the butter, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat.
Add cereal to the pot and stir until thoroughly combined.

Pour cereal mixture into the prepared baking dish and, using the back of a metal spoon, spread into the sides, forming an even layer. Sprinkle with reserved Lucky Charms marshmallows, pressing gently to adhere. Set aside to cool, about 1 hour (it will firm up as it cools).
Transfer cooled marshmallow treats to a cutting board. Peel away the parchment paper, then cut into 24 squares.
Arrange marshmallow squares on a plate and serve. Enjoy!
